placements.why: The envelope's content is an architectural decision — adopting a new database technology for the analytics pipeline. No existing strata category covers infrastructure and technology choices; Architecture is the organizational category this decision belongs to.
placements.title: Infrastructure and technology choices shaping the system
placements.frame: What architectural decisions are being made, and what rationale drives them?

placements.title: Zypherion chosen to power the analytics pipeline
placements.frame: What drives the shift to a new analytics database, and how is the decision justified and committed?
placements.why: Quinton's three speech acts form a coherent decisional narrative — declaring adoption of Zypherion, justifying it with a 15x columnar-query performance claim, and committing the org to a Q3 migration timeline. The note-taker's summary (src-4) ratifies and records the same settled decisions. This is a thematic subject future envelopes will continue to feed as the migration progresses, not a one-time fact.
